_comment: ESP32 test rig: ONE APA102 chain on ESP out6 = 8x8 matrix (px 0..63) then DotStar FeatherWing 12x6 (px 64..135), 136 px = 408 bytes in U149. PXLBLZ/Pixelblaze map: pxlblz-integration/maps/esp-test-8x8-12x6.js. Needs ESP out6 = 136 LEDs and out0 disabled. Firmware reorders colors itself, so the router sends RGB.
